purpose.summary: This is a screen-handling subprogram (component ORCGKID2) within the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles a confirmation screen (screen 2 / KID2) for medical treatment input, processing button-click events to navigate back or trigger printing of prescriptions and medication information. It sets flags and calls ORCDBMAIN to perform window transitions.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt processing)

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements for screen layout and shared areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, K01.INC through KERR2.INC, KID1.INC, KID2.INC, etc.)
Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS / EUC-JP encoded, rendered as Latin-1 mojibake)
EVALUATE ALSO (multi-subject EVALUATE) for event/widget dispatch
MCP (Message Control Program) interface pattern typical of ORCA system
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Only 1 PIC clause in working storage (rest via COPY)
verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known Japanese open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as Latin-1, causing mojibake. The 'grpsys' tokens appearing before the CALL statement are likely label prefixes or source-control markers specific to the ORCA build system. The high comment ratio (48%) is due to the extensive Japanese comment blocks.
